spans.title: A Pigeon for the Plucking
spans.blurb: An inspector arrives with a new case, and the private detective he consults cannot stop laughing at him. The trouble concerns a very worthy parish priest.
spans.spoilerNote: It gives away the running joke that the detective profits from every case the inspector brings him, which the book first springs as a surprise.

spans.title: Nothing Was Stolen
spans.blurb: A baroness hires a detective who works for free. He asks one question about her locked boudoir, then invites her to look closer at what the thief left behind.
spans.spoilerNote: It reveals that the necklace was secretly swapped for paste, the discovery this episode of the book builds toward.

spans.title: Trespassing, Fifty Dollars
spans.blurb: Three ladies drive their automobile through a rotten bridge, and the woman who owns it names her price for everything: trespassing, timber, even water.

spans.title: The Black Thread
spans.blurb: An odd, solemn man crawls up a dark staircase on his knees, striking at the empty air with his stick, while a young constable watches from below.

spans.title: A Malicious Man
spans.blurb: A flashy man with jewelled rings waits at Waterloo Station for a girl who wants nothing to do with him. Then someone takes his arm.

spans.title: The Guest Holds the Bank
spans.blurb: At a private club, a courteous elderly guest holds the bank while a steady player loses and loses, feeling his own thoughts slip out of his grip.

spans.title: Lights Out in the Library
spans.blurb: A girl kills the lights as a gunman slips into the library, then moves along the wall in blackness while he hunts her by sound and flash.

spans.title: You May Call It a Dog
spans.blurb: Called to a sleepless, ragged patient, a doctor finds a sleeve torn away in one rip and wounds the man will only half explain.

spans.title: The Cloak Drawn to Her Chin
spans.blurb: Summoned at night to a strange house, a doctor finds a bruised door, a silent weeping man, and a pale patient who answers no questions.

spans.title: The Altar on the Mountain
spans.blurb: A man remembers the mountain that filled his first nightmares, the ring of standing stones he found near its summit, and the promise a doctor made him give.

spans.title: The Visitor in Yellow Boots
spans.blurb: On his daughter's wedding day, a prosperous man receives a shabby visitor just out of prison, who believes he is owed forty thousand pounds.
spans.spoilerNote: The visitor's talk of his own boy and the daughter's wedding day hints at the revenge scheme the book soon unmasks.

spans.title: Standing in a Hole
spans.blurb: Laura plans to endure a blind date, not enjoy it. Then her date looks up at her, asks if she is standing in a hole, and ruins her gloom.
